titulo: Outlet not working? Check this first

frases.texto: Outlet not working? Check this first.
Your breakers can all look fine. The button that cut it is often in another room.
A GFCI shuts off when a little current leaks, and it kills every outlet wired after it.
frases.dicho: A G F C I shuts off when a little current leaks, and it kills every outlet wired after it.

frases.texto: Unplug everything there, and try a lamp you know works.
If you see Test and Reset, press Reset until it clicks.
No buttons? Check the bath, the kitchen, the garage, and near water. Press the one sticking out.
Still dead? Unplug what's on it, push the breaker all the way off, then on.
Don't open the outlet. If it's hot, black, or buzzing, or it will not stay on, leave the breaker off and call an electrician.
That press takes ten seconds. Calling someone to press it can cost a full hour.
Send this to that friend whose outlet just died.
